Name: Cloud Sync
Author: advxrsary
Description:
[size=4][b]CloudSync[/b][/size]

Sync your Stardew Valley saves, mod configs, and mod data to a self-hosted cloud via WebDAV.
Works with Nextcloud, ownCloud, and any WebDAV-compatible storage.

[size=3][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Auto-sync on save/load[/b] -- uploads after saving, downloads newer saves on load
[*][b]Cloud restore[/b] -- force download from cloud via console command or config toggle
[*][b]Mod config sync[/b] -- keeps mod settings in sync across machines (only for installed mods)
[*][b]Mod data sync[/b] -- syncs per-save mod data folders
[*][b]Cloud icon[/b] -- shows a cloud indicator on the save load screen for saves that exist in the cloud, with a tooltip on hover
[*][b]Manual sync hotkey[/b] -- press F6 (configurable) to trigger sync anytime
[*][b]Conflict resolution[/b] -- compares timestamps, creates local backups before overwriting
[*][b]GMCM support[/b] -- configure everything in-game via Generic Mod Config Menu
[/list]

[size=3][b]Setup[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and drop the CloudSync folder into your Mods directory
[*]Launch the game once to generate config.json
[*]Edit config.json or use GMCM to set your WebDAV server URL, username, and password
[*]That's it -- saves will sync automatically
[/list]

[size=3][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[code]
NextcloudUrl        -- WebDAV server base URL (e.g. https://cloud.example.com)
Username            -- WebDAV username
Password            -- WebDAV password
RemotePath          -- Remote folder path (default: /StardewSync)
SyncSaves           -- Sync save files (default: true)
SyncModConfigs      -- Sync mod config.json files (default: true)
SyncModData         -- Sync mod data folders (default: true)
AutoSyncOnSave      -- Auto-upload after saving (default: true)
AutoSyncOnLoad      -- Auto-download on load if cloud is newer (default: true)
AlwaysDownloadFromCloud -- Always use cloud version on load (default: false)
ManualSyncKey       -- Hotkey for manual sync (default: F6)
MaxBackups          -- Local backups to keep before overwriting (default: 3)
TimeoutSeconds      -- HTTP request timeout (default: 30)
ShowHudNotifications -- Show HUD messages for sync status (default: true)
[/code]

[size=3][b]Console Commands[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]cloudsync upload[/b] -- manually upload current save
[*][b]cloudsync download[/b] -- download if cloud version is newer
[*][b]cloudsync restore[/b] -- force download from cloud (ignores timestamps)
[*][b]cloudsync status[/b] -- show sync status and connection info
[/list]

[size=3][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]A WebDAV server (Nextcloud, ownCloud, etc.)
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for in-game settings)
[/list]

[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Works alongside other mods including MultiSave. The cloud icon is positioned to avoid overlapping with other save slot buttons.
